# Bithues — Machine-Readable Site Map

## Overview
- **Site:** bithues.com
- **Type:** Static HTML publication (book reviews, articles, original short fiction)
- **Stack:** Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, Cloudflare Pages
- **Repo:** github.com/michaelbacoti/bithues-rebuild

## Section Structure

### Stories (`/stories/`)
- Static HTML pages in `/stories/` directory
- Listing: `/stories/index.html` (JS-driven, loads from `/search.json`)
- JS pagination: `changePage(d)` function with prev/next buttons
- Card images from `item.image` in search.json → `/stories/images/{slug}.jpg`
- Individual pages: `/stories/{slug}.html`

### Articles (`/articles/`)
- Static HTML pages in `/articles/` directory
- Listing: `/articles/index.html` (JS-driven, 10 per page)
- Card images from `item.image` in search.json → `/articles/images/{slug}.jpg`
- Individual pages: `/articles/{slug}.html`

### Reviews (`/reviews/`)
- Static HTML pages in `/reviews/` directory
- Listing: `/reviews/index.html` (JS-driven, 10 per page)
- Card images from `item.image` in search.json → `/reviews/images/{slug}.jpg`
- Individual pages: `/reviews/{slug}.html`

## Key Files
- `/search.json` — All content entries (title, url, category, image, summary, excerpt)
- `/style.css` — All styles
- `/nav.js` — Site-wide navigation
- `/footer.js` — Site-wide footer
- `/_template.html` — Base template (never serve directly)

## Template Conventions
- All CSS/JS paths start with `/`
- Nav/footer loaded via `<div id="site-nav"></div>` + nav.js
- Cards use `<article class="card">` with `card-thumb`, `card-meta-top`, `card-title`, `card-excerpt`
- Listing pages use JS `fetch('/search.json')` + filter by category

## Image Paths (in search.json)
- Stories: `/stories/images/{slug}.jpg`
- Articles: `/articles/images/{slug}.jpg`
- Reviews: `/reviews/images/{slug}.jpg`

## Cards have TWO image types:
1. `card-thumb` or `support-card-thumb` — thumbnail in listing cards
2. `hero-card-thumb` or `featured-card-thumb` — hero/featured section images

## Pagination
- Listing pages: JS pagination via `changePage()` function
- Story pages: server-side `?page=N` query param for multi-page long stories
- Story page pagination in HTML: `<div class="page-nav">` with Previous/Next links
